issues.concern: The headword '返信不要' is not inherently formal. It can be used in both formal and informal contexts, depending on the surrounding phrasing and situation. Labeling it as 'formal' is misleading.
The headword '返信不要' is not inherently polite. It can be used in both polite and plain contexts, depending on the surrounding phrasing and situation. Labeling it as 'polite' is misleading.
